title: The Resurrection
speaker: Antwan Cronje
summary:
Take the resurrection out of Christianity and there's nothing left worth keeping — Paul says so himself. In the Apostles' Creed series, Pastor Antwan lays out the minimal-facts case that even non-Christian historians concede, dismantles the two most common objections, then opens 1 Corinthians 15 and Revelation 5 to show what the empty tomb actually settles. If the disciples were lying, why did every one of them die for it?

Notes: Read the sermon notes
quotes: No one dies for a lie that they know is a lie.
The empty tomb is God settling your account.
The issue is not the size of your faith but who it rests on.
